title: CJ88 settlement reversal - update termination in FLQ_INSERT_EXTSN (standard SAP Liquidity Calculation): root-cause diagnosis, no code
module: PS (CJ88 settlement) / FI-FSCM Cash and Liquidity Management (dump component FIN-FSCM-FQM)
end_client_evidence: ISSUES.md: "Gitesh S Lad (user `78087`) reports \"Update was canceled\" express documents when reversing WBS settlement via CJ88 for project `OV.13AA2002`"; ISSUES.md: "Reproduced by `SAP_ABAP` on 26/08/26 15:31–15:42 in client 500"; ISSUES.md: "deactivate classic Liquidity Calculation for company code OVL"; NOTES.md: "Gitesh S Lad (Finance & Accounts Officer, Corporate Accounts)"; NOTES.md: "client 500 (role **Test** — the client is *named* \"Production Clients\", which is misleading; SCC4 says Test)".
wricef_or_ticket: not stated (issue reported by the user; no ticket number)
business_requirement: A finance user gets "Update was canceled" express documents when reversing WBS settlement via CJ88 for project OV.13AA2002 (period 001/2026); the reversals do not post. The business needs the reversal to post.
technical_challenge: The termination is entirely in standard SAP: FLQ_INSERT_EXTSN (classic Liquidity Calculation), module 9 of 11 in the CJ88 update LUW, inserts into FLQITEMFI with the accounting-interface placeholder BELNR '%       1' instead of the FI document number, so the key is constant; the second document hits a duplicate key, INSERT returns sy-subrc 4 and FORM update_item raises INS_ERROR_IT, rolling back the whole LUW. The FM is called dynamically (where-used empty) and the only BAdI is SAP-internal.
ai_contribution: From the ST22 dump, the SM13 module list, the SE80 download of function group FLQEXT (3,636 lines) and SE16 rows, identified the crash site (LFLQEXTF01 / FORM UPDATE_ITEM line 81), the placeholder BELNR and the three orphan FLQITEMFI rows, and explained why the CJ88 log says "Settlement Reversed 24" although nothing posted. Rejected an implicit enhancement in the standard FORM and recommended deactivating classic Liquidity Calculation for company code OVL (One Exposure already active), with a test sequence, gotchas and three open questions for FI. No code was written ("diagnosis only").
manual_intervention: The error was reproduced in the system by user SAP_ABAP on 26/08/26 (41 SM13 records). The ST22 dump, the FLQEXT download and the SE16 FLQITEMFI rows were supplied. SE95 (three ways), SE18/SE19 and enhancement checks on LFLQEXTF01 / LFLQEXTU12 were run in the system and came back empty. A first download (cj88.TXT, function group KO71, 12,507 lines) turned out not to be relevant. The remedy awaits FI's decision.
status_evidence: ISSUES.md: "**Fix.** None in code — every object in the chain is standard SAP and must not be modified."; ISSUES.md: "**Files changed.** None — diagnosis only."; ISSUES.md: "**Status.** Open, waiting on FI."
quality_points: Root cause proven from the dump's variables (SY-TABIX = 1 and SY-DBCNT = 0 show the collision is with a row already on the database)
Standard code not modified; an implicit enhancement in FORM UPDATE_ITEM "deliberately rejected" because it would silently suppress or overwrite Finance data
Warned that the CJ88 log "Settlement Reversed 24" is written before the update runs - reversals must be re-verified in CJI3 / S_ALR_87013543 before any re-run
Warned not to press "Repeat Update" in SM13 for Error (no retry) records
Test sequence defined so the fix is proven before the three orphan rows are deleted
Flagged that client 500 has role Test although named "Production Clients"
